name: Lollipop Ranking
summary: Ranked stems and dots — a lighter alternative to bars for many categories, with target highlight, median line and an optional second value.
summary_zh: 细杆加圆点的排名图：类别较多时比柱状图更清爽，支持高亮目标公司、中位数参考线以及第二个数值点（如 2025E 对比 2026E）。
description_zh: 每行一个类别（通常是同业公司），细杆从 0 画到数值、末端圆点标出数值，按大小排序后一眼看出目标公司在同业中的位置。目标公司（is_target 或 highlight）用 accent-2 色圆点、加粗标签和浅色底纹突出；虚线为同业中位数（默认不含目标公司）。设置 encode.value2 后会在同一行再画一个空心点并用浅色带连接，适合展示两期倍数（EV/EBITDA 2025E→2026E）的变化；encode.group 可按行业/地区着色。
best_for: Peer ranking by valuation multiple (10–30 companies)
Scores or growth rates where bars would feel heavy
avoid_when: Values whose length from zero is not meaningful (use dumbbell / dot plot)

value.desc: Primary value (stem + filled dot); used for sorting

value2.desc: Second value drawn as a hollow dot joined to the first (e.g. next-year multiple)

highlight.desc: Boolean field marking the target row(s)

group.desc: Colour dots by group (sector / region) with a legend

highlight.desc: Label value(s) to emphasise in addition to the highlight channel

highlightBand.desc: Tinted row band behind highlighted categories

refExcludeHighlight.desc: Compute the median / mean without the highlighted (target) rows

labels.desc: Value labels beyond the outer dot (both values when value2 is set)

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field's format

zoom.desc: Scroll / zoom along the category axis for long lists

interactions: Hover tooltip with premium / (discount) to the median and period change
Optional category zoom for long lists
